Enable/disable use of IP/MAC binding to filter packets that would normally go through the firewall.   
enable:Enable IP/MAC binding for packets that would normally go through the firewall.   
disable:Disable IP/MAC binding for packets that would normally go through the firewall.

disable:Disable IP/MAC binding for packets that would normally go to the firewall.

undefinedhost.description:

block:Block packets from MAC addresses not in the IP/MAC list.

__*Note:*__ This parameter can only be used when the *action* parameter is set to *move*.

parameters.name: after

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Possible parameters to go in the body for the request

guaranteed-bandwidth.description: Amount of bandwidth guaranteed for this shaper (0 - 80000000). Units depend on the bandwidth-unit setting.

maximum-bandwidth.description: Upper bandwidth limit enforced by this shaper (0 - 80000000). 0 means no limit. Units depend on the bandwidth-unit setting.

bandwidth-unit.description:
Unit of measurement for guaranteed and maximum bandwidth for this shaper (Kbps, Mbps or Gbps).   
kbps:Kilobits per second.   
mbps:Megabits per second.   
gbps:Gigabits per second.

priority.description:
Higher priority traffic is more likely to be forwarded without delays and without compromising the guaranteed bandwidth.   
low:Low priority.   
medium:Medium priority.   
high:High priority.

per-policy.description:
Enable/disable applying a separate shaper for each policy. For example, if enabled the guaranteed bandwidth is applied separately for each policy.   
disable:All referring policies share one traffic shaper.   
enable:Each referring policy has its own traffic shaper.

diffserv.description:
Enable/disable changing the DiffServ setting applied to traffic accepted by this shaper.   
enable:Enable setting traffic DiffServ.   
disable:Disable setting traffic DiffServ.

diffservcode.description: DiffServ setting to be applied to traffic accepted by this shaper.

dscp-marking-method.description:
Select DSCP marking method.   
multi-stage:Multistage marking.   
static:Static marking.

exceed-bandwidth.description: Exceed bandwidth used for DSCP multi-stage marking. Units depend on the bandwidth-unit setting.

exceed-dscp.description: DSCP mark for traffic in guaranteed-bandwidth and exceed-bandwidth.

maximum-dscp.description: DSCP mark for traffic in exceed-bandwidth and maximum-bandwidth.

overhead.description: Per-packet size overhead used in rate computations.

exceed-class-id.description: Class ID for traffic in guaranteed-bandwidth and maximum-bandwidth.

parameters.name: vdom
parameters.description:
Specify the Virtual Domain(s) from which results are returned or changes are applied to. If this parameter is not provided, the management VDOM will be used. If the admin does not have access to the VDOM, a permission error will be returned.
The URL parameter is one of:
vdom=root (Single VDOM)
vdom=vdom1,vdom2 (Multiple VDOMs)
vdom=* (All VDOMs)

parameters.name: action
parameters.description:
If supported, an action can be specified.
_move_: Move this specific resource.
When *action=move* is set, one of the extra parameters (*before*, *after*) must be provided.
__*Note:*__ If this parameter is provided when not supported, the action will be ignored and an “invalid request” error will be returned.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description:
If *action=move*, use *before* to specify the ID of the resource that this resource will be moved before.
For example, to move `object 1` to before `object 2`, use:
__action=move&before=2__
__*Note:*__ This parameter can only be used when the *action* parameter is set to *move*.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description:
If *action=move*, use *after* to specify the ID of the resource that this resource will be moved after.
For example, to move `object 1` to after `object 3`, use:
__action=move&after=3__
__*Note:*__ This parameter can only be used when the *action* parameter is set to *move*.

parameters.name: vdom
parameters.description:
Specify the Virtual Domain(s) from which results are returned or changes are applied to. If this parameter is not provided, the management VDOM will be used. If the admin does not have access to the VDOM, a permission error will be returned.
The URL parameter is one of:
vdom=root (Single VDOM)
vdom=vdom1,vdom2 (Multiple VDOMs)
vdom=* (All VDOMs)

parameters.name: action
parameters.description:
If supported, an action can be specified.
_move_: Move this specific resource.
When *action=move* is set, one of the extra parameters (*before*, *after*) must be provided.
__*Note:*__ If this parameter is provided when not supported, the action will be ignored and an “invalid request” error will be returned.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description:
If *action=move*, use *before* to specify the ID of the resource that this resource will be moved before.
For example, to move `object 1` to before `object 2`, use:
__action=move&before=2__
__*Note:*__ This parameter can only be used when the *action* parameter is set to *move*.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description:
If *action=move*, use *after* to specify the ID of the resource that this resource will be moved after.
For example, to move `object 1` to after `object 3`, use:
__action=move&after=3__
__*Note:*__ This parameter can only be used when the *action* parameter is set to *move*.

active:Server status active.   
standby:Server status standby.   
disable:Server status disable.

type.description:
TCP forwarding server type.   
tcp-forwarding:TCP forwarding.   
ssh:SSH.

weight.description: Weight of the real server. If weighted load balancing is enabled, the server with the highest weight gets more connections.

http-host.description: HTTP server domain name in HTTP header.

health-check.description:
Enable to check the responsiveness of the real server before forwarding traffic.   
disable:Disable per server health check.   
enable:Enable per server health check.

health-check-proto.description:
Protocol of the health check monitor to use when polling to determine server's connectivity status.   
ping:Use PING to test the link with the server.   
http:Use HTTP-GET to test the link with the server.   
tcp-connect:Use a full TCP connection to test the link with the server.

holddown-interval.description:
Enable/disable holddown timer. Server will be considered active and reachable once the holddown period has expired (30 seconds).   
enable:Enable per server holddown.   
disable:Disable per server holddown.

ssh-client-cert.description: Set access-proxy SSH client certificate profile.

ssh-host-key-validation.description:
Enable/disable SSH real server host key validation.   
disable:Disable SSH real server host key validation.   
enable:Enable SSH real server host key validation.

ssh-host-key.description: One or more server host key.

persistence.description:
Configure how to make sure that clients connect to the same server every time they make a request that is part of the same session.   
none:None.   
http-cookie:HTTP cookie.

http-cookie-domain-from-host.description:
Enable/disable use of HTTP cookie domain from host field in HTTP.   
disable:Disable use of HTTP cookie domain from host field in HTTP (use http-cooke-domain setting).   
enable:Enable use of HTTP cookie domain from host field in HTTP.

http-cookie-domain.description: Domain that HTTP cookie persistence should apply to.

http-cookie-path.description: Limit HTTP cookie persistence to the specified path.

http-cookie-generation.description: Generation of HTTP cookie to be accepted. Changing invalidates all existing cookies.

http-cookie-age.description: Time in minutes that client web browsers should keep a cookie. Default is 60 minutes. 0 = no time limit.

http-cookie-share.description:
Control sharing of cookies across API Gateway. Use of same-ip means a cookie from one virtual server can be used by another. Disable stops cookie sharing.   
disable:Only allow HTTP cookie to match this API Gateway.   
same-ip:Allow HTTP cookie to match any API Gateway with same IP.

https-cookie-secure.description:
Enable/disable verification that inserted HTTPS cookies are secure.   
disable:Do not mark cookie as secure, allow sharing between an HTTP and HTTPS connection.   
enable:Mark inserted cookie as secure, cookie can only be used for HTTPS a connection.

saml-server.description: SAML service provider configuration for VIP authentication.

saml-redirect.description:
Enable/disable SAML redirection after successful authentication.   
disable:Do not support redirection after successful SAML authentication.   
enable:Support redirection after successful SAML authentication.

ssl-dh-bits.description:

768:768-bit Diffie-Hellman prime.   
1024:1024-bit Diffie-Hellman prime.   
1536:1536-bit Diffie-Hellman prime.   
2048:2048-bit Diffie-Hellman prime.   
3072:3072-bit Diffie-Hellman prime.   
4096:4096-bit Diffie-Hellman prime.

high:High encryption. Allow only AES and ChaCha.   
medium:Medium encryption. Allow AES, ChaCha, 3DES, and RC4.   
low:Low encryption. Allow AES, ChaCha, 3DES, RC4, and DES.

!=     |    Does not match with pattern (case insensitive).
=@     |    Pattern found in object value (case insensitive).
!@     |    ﻿Pattern not﻿ found in object value (case insensitive).
<=     |    Value must be less than or equal to ﻿pattern﻿.
<     |    Value must be less than pattern﻿.
.>=    |    Value must be greater than or equal to ﻿pattern﻿.
.>     |    Value must be greater than ﻿pattern﻿.
Logical OR    |    Separate filters using commas ','
Logical AND    |    Filter strings can be combined to create logical AND queries by including multiple filters in the request.
Combining AND and OR    |    You can combine AND and OR filters together to create more complex filters.

deny:Blocks sessions that match the firewall policy.

disable:Disable NAT64.

nat46.description:

disable:Disable zero trust network access.

disable:Disable use of Internet Services in policy.

disable:Disable use of Internet Services source in policy.

disable:Disable schedule timeout.

anti-replay.description:

disable:Disable anti-replay check.

group:Allow security profile groups.

parameters.name: nkey

For example, to clone `address1` to `address1_clone`, use:
__action=clone&nkey=address1_clone__
__*Note:*__ This parameter can only be used when the *action* parameter is set to *clone*.

parameters.description:
Specify the Virtual Domain(s) from which results are returned or changes are applied to. If this parameter is not provided, the management VDOM will be used. If the admin does not have access to the VDOM, a permission error will be returned.
The URL parameter is one of:
vdom=root (Single VDOM)
vdom=vdom1,vdom2 (Multiple VDOMs)
vdom=* (All VDOMs)

parameters.name: action
parameters.description:
If supported, an action can be specified.
_move_: Move this specific resource.
When *action=move* is set, one of the extra parameters (*before*, *after*) must be provided.
__*Note:*__ If this parameter is provided when not supported, the action will be ignored and an “invalid request” error will be returned.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description:
If *action=move*, use *before* to specify the ID of the resource that this resource will be moved before.
For example, to move `object 1` to before `object 2`, use:
__action=move&before=2__
__*Note:*__ This parameter can only be used when the *action* parameter is set to *move*.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description:
If *action=move*, use *after* to specify the ID of the resource that this resource will be moved after.
For example, to move `object 1` to after `object 3`, use:
__action=move&after=3__
__*Note:*__ This parameter can only be used when the *action* parameter is set to *move*.

parameters.name: vdom
parameters.description:
Specify the Virtual Domain(s) from which results are returned or changes are applied to. If this parameter is not provided, the management VDOM will be used. If the admin does not have access to the VDOM, a permission error will be returned.
The URL parameter is one of:
vdom=root (Single VDOM)
vdom=vdom1,vdom2 (Multiple VDOMs)
vdom=* (All VDOMs)

parameters.name: action
parameters.description:
If supported, an action can be specified.
_move_: Move this specific resource.
When *action=move* is set, one of the extra parameters (*before*, *after*) must be provided.
__*Note:*__ If this parameter is provided when not supported, the action will be ignored and an “invalid request” error will be returned.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description:
If *action=move*, use *before* to specify the ID of the resource that this resource will be moved before.
For example, to move `object 1` to before `object 2`, use:
__action=move&before=2__
__*Note:*__ This parameter can only be used when the *action* parameter is set to *move*.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description:
If *action=move*, use *after* to specify the ID of the resource that this resource will be moved after.
For example, to move `object 1` to after `object 3`, use:
__action=move&after=3__
__*Note:*__ This parameter can only be used when the *action* parameter is set to *move*.

Specify the Virtual Domain(s) from which results are returned or changes are applied to. If this parameter is not provided, the management VDOM will be used. If the admin does not have access to the VDOM, a permission error will be returned.
The URL parameter is one of:
vdom=root (Single VDOM)
vdom=vdom1,vdom2 (Multiple VDOMs)
vdom=* (All VDOMs)

parameters.name: action
parameters.description:
If supported, an action can be specified.
_move_: Move this specific resource.
When *action=move* is set, one of the extra parameters (*before*, *after*) must be provided.
__*Note:*__ If this parameter is provided when not supported, the action will be ignored and an “invalid request” error will be returned.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description:
If *action=move*, use *before* to specify the ID of the resource that this resource will be moved before.
For example, to move `object 1` to before `object 2`, use:
__action=move&before=2__
__*Note:*__ This parameter can only be used when the *action* parameter is set to *move*.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description:
If *action=move*, use *after* to specify the ID of the resource that this resource will be moved after.
For example, to move `object 1` to after `object 3`, use:
__action=move&after=3__
__*Note:*__ This parameter can only be used when the *action* parameter is set to *move*.

count:Expire session states when this maximum is reached.

vdom=* (All VDOMs)

parameters.name: action
parameters.description:
If supported, an action can be specified.
_move_: Move this specific resource.
When *action=move* is set, one of the extra parameters (*before*, *after*) must be provided.
__*Note:*__ If this parameter is provided when not supported, the action will be ignored and an “invalid request” error will be returned.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description:
If *action=move*, use *before* to specify the ID of the resource that this resource will be moved before.
For example, to move `object 1` to before `object 2`, use:
__action=move&before=2__
__*Note:*__ This parameter can only be used when the *action* parameter is set to *move*.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description:
If *action=move*, use *after* to specify the ID of the resource that this resource will be moved after.
For example, to move `object 1` to after `object 3`, use:
__action=move&after=3__
__*Note:*__ This parameter can only be used when the *action* parameter is set to *move*.

Enable/disable forcing the source NAT mapped IP to the external IP for all traffic.   
disable:Force only the source NAT mapped IP to the external IP for traffic egressing the external interface of the VIP.   
enable:Force the source NAT mapped IP to the external IP for all traffic.

portforward.description:
Enable/disable port forwarding.   
disable:Disable port forward.   
enable:Enable port forward.

status.description:
Enable/disable VIP.   
disable:Disable the VIP.   
enable:Enable the VIP.

protocol.description:
Protocol to use when forwarding packets.   
tcp:TCP.   
udp:UDP.   
sctp:SCTP.   
icmp:ICMP.

extport.description: Incoming port number range that you want to map to a port number range on the destination network.

mappedport.description: Port number range on the destination network to which the external port number range is mapped.

gratuitous-arp-interval.description: Enable to have the VIP send gratuitous ARPs. 0=disabled. Set from 5 up to 8640000 seconds to enable.

srcintf-filter.description: Interfaces to which the VIP applies. Separate the names with spaces.

portmapping-type.description:
Port mapping type.   
1-to-1:One to one.   
m-to-n:Many to many.

realservers.description: Select the real servers that this server load balancing VIP will distribute traffic to.

type.description:
Type of address.   
ip:Standard IPv4 address.   
address:Dynamic address object.

address.description: Dynamic address of the real server.

ip.description: IP address of the real server.

port.description: Port for communicating with the real server. Required if port forwarding is enabled.

status.description:
Set the status of the real server to active so that it can accept traffic, or on standby or disabled so no traffic is sent.   
active:Server status active.   
standby:Server status standby.   
disable:Server status disable.

weight.description: Weight of the real server. If weighted load balancing is enabled, the server with the highest weight gets more connections.

holddown-interval.description: Time in seconds that the health check monitor continues to monitor and unresponsive server that should be active.

healthcheck.description:
Enable to check the responsiveness of the real server before forwarding traffic.   
disable:Disable per server health check.   
enable:Enable per server health check.   
vip:Use health check defined in VIP.

http-host.description: HTTP server domain name in HTTP header.

max-connections.description: Max number of active connections that can be directed to the real server. When reached, sessions are sent to other real servers.

monitor.description: Name of the health check monitor to use when polling to determine a virtual server's connectivity status.

client-ip.description: Only clients in this IP range can connect to this real server.

http-cookie-domain-from-host.description:
Enable/disable use of HTTP cookie domain from host field in HTTP.   
disable:Disable use of HTTP cookie domain from host field in HTTP (use http-cooke-domain setting).   
enable:Enable use of HTTP cookie domain from host field in HTTP.

http-cookie-domain.description: Domain that HTTP cookie persistence should apply to.

http-cookie-path.description: Limit HTTP cookie persistence to the specified path.

http-cookie-generation.description: Generation of HTTP cookie to be accepted. Changing invalidates all existing cookies.

http-cookie-age.description: Time in minutes that client web browsers should keep a cookie. Default is 60 minutes. 0 = no time limit.

http-cookie-share.description:
Control sharing of cookies across virtual servers. Use of same-ip means a cookie from one virtual server can be used by another. Disable stops cookie sharing.   
disable:Only allow HTTP cookie to match this virtual server.   
same-ip:Allow HTTP cookie to match any virtual server with same IP.

https-cookie-secure.description:
Enable/disable verification that inserted HTTPS cookies are secure.   
disable:Do not mark cookie as secure, allow sharing between an HTTP and HTTPS connection.   
enable:Mark inserted cookie as secure, cookie can only be used for HTTPS a connection.

http-multiplex.description:
Enable/disable HTTP multiplexing.   
enable:Enable HTTP session multiplexing.   
disable:Disable HTTP session multiplexing.

http-ip-header.description:
For HTTP multiplexing, enable to add the original client IP address in the XForwarded-For HTTP header.   
enable:Enable adding HTTP header.   
disable:Disable adding HTTP header.

http-ip-header-name.description: For HTTP multiplexing, enter a custom HTTPS header name. The original client IP address is added to this header. If empty, X-Forwarded-For is used.

outlook-web-access.description:
Enable to add the Front-End-Https header for Microsoft Outlook Web Access.   
disable:Disable Outlook Web Access support.   
enable:Enable Outlook Web Access support.

weblogic-server.description:
Enable to add an HTTP header to indicate SSL offloading for a WebLogic server.   
disable:Do not add HTTP header indicating SSL offload for WebLogic server.   
enable:Add HTTP header indicating SSL offload for WebLogic server.

websphere-server.description:
Enable to add an HTTP header to indicate SSL offloading for a WebSphere server.   
disable:Do not add HTTP header indicating SSL offload for WebSphere server.   
enable:Add HTTP header indicating SSL offload for WebSphere server.

ssl-mode.description:
Apply SSL offloading between the client and the FortiGate (half) or from the client to the FortiGate and from the FortiGate to the server (full).   
half:Client to FortiGate SSL.   
full:Client to FortiGate and FortiGate to Server SSL.

ssl-certificate.description: The name of the certificate to use for SSL handshake.

ssl-dh-bits.description:
Number of bits to use in the Diffie-Hellman exchange for RSA encryption of SSL sessions.   
768:768-bit Diffie-Hellman prime.   
1024:1024-bit Diffie-Hellman prime.   
1536:1536-bit Diffie-Hellman prime.   
2048:2048-bit Diffie-Hellman prime.   
3072:3072-bit Diffie-Hellman prime.   
4096:4096-bit Diffie-Hellman prime.

custom:Custom encryption. Use config ssl-cipher-suites to select the cipher suites that are allowed.

ssl-pfs.description:
Select the cipher suites that can be used for SSL perfect forward secrecy (PFS). Applies to both client and server sessions.   
require:Allow only Diffie-Hellman cipher-suites, so PFS is applied.   
deny:Allow only non-Diffie-Hellman cipher-suites, so PFS is not applied.   
allow:Allow use of any cipher suite so PFS may or may not be used depending on the cipher suite selected.

ssl-min-version.description:
Lowest SSL/TLS version acceptable from a client.

tls-1.0:TLS 1.0.   
tls-1.1:TLS 1.1.   
tls-1.2:TLS 1.2.   
tls-1.3:TLS 1.3.

ssl-max-version.description:
Highest SSL/TLS version acceptable from a client.   
ssl-3.0:SSL 3.0.   
tls-1.0:TLS 1.0.   
tls-1.1:TLS 1.1.   
tls-1.2:TLS 1.2.   
tls-1.3:TLS 1.3.

ssl-server-min-version.description:
Lowest SSL/TLS version acceptable from a server. Use the client setting by default.   
ssl-3.0:SSL 3.0.   
tls-1.0:TLS 1.0.   
tls-1.1:TLS 1.1.   
tls-1.2:TLS 1.2.   
tls-1.3:TLS 1.3.   
client:Use same value as client configuration.

ssl-server-max-version.description:
Highest SSL/TLS version acceptable from a server. Use the client setting by default.   
ssl-3.0:SSL 3.0.   
tls-1.0:TLS 1.0.   
tls-1.1:TLS 1.1.   
tls-1.2:TLS 1.2.   
tls-1.3:TLS 1.3.   
client:Use same value as client configuration.

ssl-accept-ffdhe-groups.description:
Enable/disable FFDHE cipher suite for SSL key exchange.   
enable:Accept FFDHE groups.   
disable:Do not accept FFDHE groups.

ssl-send-empty-frags.description:
Enable/disable sending empty fragments to avoid CBC IV attacks (SSL 3.0 & TLS 1.0 only). May need to be disabled for compatibility with older systems.   
enable:Send empty fragments.   
disable:Do not send empty fragments.

ssl-client-fallback.description:
Enable/disable support for preventing Downgrade Attacks on client connections (RFC 7507).   
disable:Disable.   
enable:Enable.

ssl-client-renegotiation.description:
Allow, deny, or require secure renegotiation of client sessions to comply with RFC 5746.   
allow:Allow a SSL client to renegotiate.   
deny:Abort any client initiated SSL re-negotiation attempt.   
secure:Abort any client initiated SSL re-negotiation attempt that does not use RFC 5746 Secure Renegotiation.

ssl-client-session-state-type.description:
How to expire SSL sessions for the segment of the SSL connection between the client and the FortiGate.   
disable:Do not keep session states.   
time:Expire session states after this many minutes.   
count:Expire session states when this maximum is reached.   
both:Expire session states based on time or count, whichever occurs first.

ssl-client-session-state-timeout.description: Number of minutes to keep client to FortiGate SSL session state.

ssl-client-session-state-max.description: Maximum number of client to FortiGate SSL session states to keep.

ssl-client-rekey-count.description: Maximum length of data in MB before triggering a client rekey (0 = disable).

ssl-server-session-state-type.description:
How to expire SSL sessions for the segment of the SSL connection between the server and the FortiGate.   
disable:Do not keep session states.   
time:Expire session states after this many minutes.   
count:Expire session states when this maximum is reached.   
both:Expire session states based on time or count, whichever occurs first.

ssl-server-session-state-timeout.description: Number of minutes to keep FortiGate to Server SSL session state.

ssl-server-session-state-max.description: Maximum number of FortiGate to Server SSL session states to keep.

ssl-http-location-conversion.description:
Enable to replace HTTP with HTTPS in the reply's Location HTTP header field.   
enable:Enable HTTP location conversion.   
disable:Disable HTTP location conversion.

ssl-http-match-host.description:
Enable/disable HTTP host matching for location conversion.   
enable:Match HTTP host in response header.   
disable:Do not match HTTP host.

ssl-hpkp.description:
Enable/disable including HPKP header in response.   
disable:Do not add a HPKP header to each HTTP response.   
enable:Add a HPKP header to each a HTTP response.   
report-only:Add a HPKP Report-Only header to each HTTP response.

ssl-hpkp-backup.description: Certificate to generate backup HPKP pin from.

ssl-hpkp-age.description: Number of seconds the client should honor the HPKP setting.

ssl-hpkp-include-subdomains.description:

ssl-hsts.description:
Enable/disable including HSTS header in response.   
disable:Do not add a HSTS header to each a HTTP response.   
enable:Add a HSTS header to each HTTP response.

ssl-hsts-age.description: Number of seconds the client should honor the HSTS setting.

ssl-hsts-include-subdomains.description:

parameters.description:

For example, to clone `address1` to `address1_clone`, use:

__*Note:*__ This parameter can only be used when the *action* parameter is set to *clone*.

ssl-pfs.description:
Select the cipher suites that can be used for SSL perfect forward secrecy (PFS). Applies to both client and server sessions.   
require:Allow only Diffie-Hellman cipher-suites, so PFS is applied.   
deny:Allow only non-Diffie-Hellman cipher-suites, so PFS is not applied.   
allow:Allow use of any cipher suite so PFS may or may not be used depending on the cipher suite selected.

ssl-min-version.description:
Lowest SSL/TLS version acceptable from a client.   
ssl-3.0:SSL 3.0.   
tls-1.0:TLS 1.0.   
tls-1.1:TLS 1.1.   
tls-1.2:TLS 1.2.   
tls-1.3:TLS 1.3.

ssl-max-version.description:
Highest SSL/TLS version acceptable from a client.   
ssl-3.0:SSL 3.0.   
tls-1.0:TLS 1.0.   
tls-1.1:TLS 1.1.   
tls-1.2:TLS 1.2.   
tls-1.3:TLS 1.3.

ssl-server-min-version.description:
Lowest SSL/TLS version acceptable from a server. Use the client setting by default.   
ssl-3.0:SSL 3.0.   
tls-1.0:TLS 1.0.   
tls-1.1:TLS 1.1.   
tls-1.2:TLS 1.2.   
tls-1.3:TLS 1.3.   
client:Use same value as client configuration.

ssl-server-max-version.description:
Highest SSL/TLS version acceptable from a server. Use the client setting by default.   
ssl-3.0:SSL 3.0.   
tls-1.0:TLS 1.0.   
tls-1.1:TLS 1.1.   
tls-1.2:TLS 1.2.   
tls-1.3:TLS 1.3.   
client:Use same value as client configuration.

ssl-accept-ffdhe-groups.description:
Enable/disable FFDHE cipher suite for SSL key exchange.   
enable:Accept FFDHE groups.   
disable:Do not accept FFDHE groups.

ssl-send-empty-frags.description:
Enable/disable sending empty fragments to avoid CBC IV attacks (SSL 3.0 & TLS 1.0 only). May need to be disabled for compatibility with older systems.   
enable:Send empty fragments.   
disable:Do not send empty fragments.

ssl-client-fallback.description:
Enable/disable support for preventing Downgrade Attacks on client connections (RFC 7507).   
disable:Disable.   
enable:Enable.

ssl-client-renegotiation.description:
Allow, deny, or require secure renegotiation of client sessions to comply with RFC 5746.   
allow:Allow a SSL client to renegotiate.   
deny:Abort any SSL connection that attempts to renegotiate.   
secure:Reject any SSL connection that does not offer a RFC 5746 Secure Renegotiation Indication.

ssl-client-session-state-type.description:
How to expire SSL sessions for the segment of the SSL connection between the client and the FortiGate.   
disable:Do not keep session states.   
time:Expire session states after this many minutes.   
count:Expire session states when this maximum is reached.   
both:Expire session states based on time or count, whichever occurs first.

ssl-client-session-state-timeout.description: Number of minutes to keep client to FortiGate SSL session state.

ssl-client-session-state-max.description: Maximum number of client to FortiGate SSL session states to keep.

ssl-client-rekey-count.description: Maximum length of data in MB before triggering a client rekey (0 = disable).

ssl-server-session-state-type.description:
How to expire SSL sessions for the segment of the SSL connection between the server and the FortiGate.   
disable:Do not keep session states.   
time:Expire session states after this many minutes.   
count:Expire session states when this maximum is reached.   
both:Expire session states based on time or count, whichever occurs first.

ssl-server-session-state-timeout.description: Number of minutes to keep FortiGate to Server SSL session state.

ssl-server-session-state-max.description: Maximum number of FortiGate to Server SSL session states to keep.

ssl-http-location-conversion.description:
Enable to replace HTTP with HTTPS in the reply's Location HTTP header field.   
enable:Enable HTTP location conversion.   
disable:Disable HTTP location conversion.

ssl-http-match-host.description:
Enable/disable HTTP host matching for location conversion.   
enable:Match HTTP host in response header.   
disable:Do not match HTTP host.

ssl-hpkp.description:
Enable/disable including HPKP header in response.   
disable:Do not add a HPKP header to each HTTP response.   
enable:Add a HPKP header to each a HTTP response.   
report-only:Add a HPKP Report-Only header to each HTTP response.

ssl-hpkp-primary.description: Certificate to generate primary HPKP pin from.

ssl-hpkp-backup.description: Certificate to generate backup HPKP pin from.

ssl-hpkp-age.description: Number of minutes the web browser should keep HPKP.

ssl-hpkp-report-uri.description: URL to report HPKP violations to.

ssl-hpkp-include-subdomains.description:
Indicate that HPKP header applies to all subdomains.   
disable:HPKP header does not apply to subdomains.   
enable:HPKP header applies to subdomains.

ssl-hsts.description:
Enable/disable including HSTS header in response.   
disable:Do not add a HSTS header to each a HTTP response.   
enable:Add a HSTS header to each HTTP response.

ssl-hsts-age.description: Number of seconds the client should honor the HSTS setting.

ssl-hsts-include-subdomains.description:
Indicate that HSTS header applies to all subdomains.   
disable:HSTS header does not apply to subdomains.   
enable:HSTS header applies to subdomains.

monitor.description: Name of the health check monitor to use when polling to determine a virtual server's connectivity status.

embedded-ipv4-address.description:
Enable/disable use of the lower 32 bits of the external IPv6 address as mapped IPv4 address.   
disable:Disable use of the lower 32 bits of the external IPv6 address as mapped IPv4 address.   
enable:Enable use of the lower 32 bits of the external IPv6 address as mapped IPv4 address.

ipv4-mappedip.description: Range of mapped IP addresses. Specify the start IP address followed by a space and the end IP address.

ipv4-mappedport.description: IPv4 port number range on the destination network to which the external port number range is mapped.

500.description: Internal Server Error: Internal error when processing the request

413.description: Request Entity Too Large: Request cannot be processed due to large entity

429.description: Access temporarily blocked: Maximum failed authentications reached. The offended source is temporarily blocked for certain amount of time.

parameters.name: vdom
parameters.description:
Specify the Virtual Domain(s) from which results are returned or changes are applied to. If this parameter is not provided, the management VDOM will be used. If the admin does not have access to the VDOM, a permission error will be returned.
The URL parameter is one of:
vdom=root (Single VDOM)
vdom=vdom1,vdom2 (Multiple VDOMs)
vdom=* (All VDOMs)

uuid.description: Universally Unique Identifier (UUID; automatically assigned but can be manually reset).

type.description:

static-nat:Static NAT.   
server-load-balance:Server load balance.   
access-proxy:Access proxy.

src-filter.description: Source IP6 filter (x:x:x:x:x:x:x:x/x). Separate addresses with spaces.

extip.description: IPv6 address or address range on the external interface that you want to map to an address or address range on the destination network.

mappedip.description: Mapped IPv6 address range in the format startIP-endIP.

nat-source-vip.description:
Enable to perform SNAT on traffic from mappedip to the extip for all egress interfaces.   
disable:Disable nat-source-vip.   
enable:Perform SNAT on traffic from mappedip to the extip for all egress interfaces.

ndp-reply.description:
Enable/disable this FortiGate unit's ability to respond to NDP requests for this virtual IP address (default = enable).   
disable:Disable this FortiGate unit's ability to respond to NDP requests for this virtual IP address.   
enable:Enable this FortiGate unit's ability to respond to NDP requests for this virtual IP address.

portforward.description:
Enable port forwarding.   
disable:Disable port forward.   
enable:Enable/disable port forwarding.

protocol.description:
Protocol to use when forwarding packets.   
tcp:TCP.   
udp:UDP.   
sctp:SCTP.

extport.description: Incoming port number range that you want to map to a port number range on the destination network.

mappedport.description: Port number range on the destination network to which the external port number range is mapped.

color.description: Color of icon on the GUI.

ldb-method.description:
Method used to distribute sessions to real servers.   
static:Distribute sessions based on source IP.   
round-robin:Distribute sessions based round robin order.   
weighted:Distribute sessions based on weight.   
least-session:Sends new sessions to the server with the lowest session count.   
least-rtt:Distribute new sessions to the server with lowest Round-Trip-Time.   
first-alive:Distribute sessions to the first server that is alive.   
http-host:Distribute sessions to servers based on host field in HTTP header.

server-type.description:

https:HTTPS.   
imaps:IMAPS.   
pop3s:POP3S.   
smtps:SMTPS.   
ssl:SSL.   
tcp:TCP.   
udp:UDP.

Enable/disable redirection of HTTP to HTTPS.   
enable:Enable redirection of HTTP to HTTPS.   
disable:Disable redirection of HTTP to HTTPS.

enable:Enable DNAT66.

nat64.description:
Enable/disable DNAT64.

add-nat64-route.description:

enable:Enable adding NAT64 route.

realservers.description: Select the real servers that this server load balancing VIP will distribute traffic to.

ip.description: IP address of the real server.

status.description:

active:Server status active.   
standby:Server status standby.   
disable:Server status disable.

weight.description: Weight of the real server. If weighted load balancing is enabled, the server with the highest weight gets more connections.

holddown-interval.description: Time in seconds that the health check monitor continues to monitor an unresponsive server that should be active.

healthcheck.description:
Enable to check the responsiveness of the real server before forwarding traffic.   
disable:Disable per server health check.   
enable:Enable per server health check.   
vip:Use health check defined in VIP.

http-host.description: HTTP server domain name in HTTP header.

max-connections.description: Max number of active connections that can directed to the real server. When reached, sessions are sent to other real servers.

monitor.description: Name of the health check monitor to use when polling to determine a virtual server's connectivity status.

client-ip.description: Only clients in this IP range can connect to this real server.

http-cookie-domain-from-host.description:

http-cookie-domain.description: Domain that HTTP cookie persistence should apply to.

http-cookie-path.description: Limit HTTP cookie persistence to the specified path.

http-cookie-generation.description: Generation of HTTP cookie to be accepted. Changing invalidates all existing cookies.

http-cookie-age.description: Time in minutes that client web browsers should keep a cookie. Default is 60 minutes. 0 = no time limit.

http-cookie-share.description:
Control sharing of cookies across virtual servers. Use of same-ip means a cookie from one virtual server can be used by another. Disable stops cookie sharing.   
disable:Only allow HTTP cookie to match this virtual server.   
same-ip:Allow HTTP cookie to match any virtual server with same IP.

https-cookie-secure.description:
Enable/disable verification that inserted HTTPS cookies are secure.

disable:Disable HTTP session multiplexing.

http-ip-header.description:

enable:Enable adding HTTP header.   
disable:Disable adding HTTP header.

http-ip-header-name.description: For HTTP multiplexing, enter a custom HTTPS header name. The original client IP address is added to this header. If empty, X-Forwarded-For is used.

outlook-web-access.description:

weblogic-server.description:

When *action=move* is set, one of the extra parameters (*before*, *after*) must be provided.
__*Note:*__ If this parameter is provided when not supported, the action will be ignored and an “invalid request” error will be returned.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description:
If *action=move*, use *before* to specify the ID of the resource that this resource will be moved before.
For example, to move `object 1` to before `object 2`, use:
__action=move&before=2__
__*Note:*__ This parameter can only be used when the *action* parameter is set to *move*.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description:
If *action=move*, use *after* to specify the ID of the resource that this resource will be moved after.
For example, to move `object 1` to after `object 3`, use:
__action=move&after=3__
__*Note:*__ This parameter can only be used when the *action* parameter is set to *move*.

disable:Do not accept FFDHE groups.

Enable/disable sending empty fragments to avoid CBC IV attacks (SSL 3.0 & TLS 1.0 only). May need to be disabled for compatibility with older systems.   
enable:Send empty fragments.   
disable:Do not send empty fragments.

ssl-client-fallback.description:
Enable/disable support for preventing Downgrade Attacks on client connections (RFC 7507).   
disable:Disable.   
enable:Enable.

Allow, deny, or require secure renegotiation of client sessions to comply with RFC 5746.   
allow:Allow a SSL client to renegotiate.   
deny:Abort any SSL connection that attempts to renegotiate.   
secure:Reject any SSL connection that does not offer a RFC 5746 Secure Renegotiation Indication.

disable:Do not keep session states.   
time:Expire session states after this many minutes.   
count:Expire session states when this maximum is reached.   
both:Expire session states based on time or count, whichever occurs first.

ssl-client-session-state-max.description: Maximum number of client to FortiGate SSL session states to keep.

ssl-server-session-state-type.description:

disable:Do not keep session states.   
time:Expire session states after this many minutes.   
count:Expire session states when this maximum is reached.   
both:Expire session states based on time or count, whichever occurs first.

ssl-server-session-state-max.description: Maximum number of FortiGate to Server SSL session states to keep.

disable:Disable HTTP location conversion.

disable:Do not match HTTP host.

realservers.description: Select the real servers that this server load balancing VIP will distribute traffic to.

ip.description: IP address of the real server.

port.description: Port for communicating with the real server. Required if port forwarding is enabled.

status.description:
Set the status of the real server to active so that it can accept traffic, or on standby or disabled so no traffic is sent.   
active:Server status active.   
standby:Server status standby.   
disable:Server status disable.

weight.description: Weight of the real server. If weighted load balancing is enabled, the server with the highest weight gets more connections.

holddown-interval.description: Time in seconds that the health check monitor continues to monitor an unresponsive server that should be active.

healthcheck.description:
Enable to check the responsiveness of the real server before forwarding traffic.   
disable:Disable per server health check.   
enable:Enable per server health check.   
vip:Use health check defined in VIP.

http-host.description: HTTP server domain name in HTTP header.

max-connections.description: Max number of active connections that can directed to the real server. When reached, sessions are sent to other real servers.

monitor.description: Name of the health check monitor to use when polling to determine a virtual server's connectivity status.

client-ip.description: Only clients in this IP range can connect to this real server.

http-cookie-domain-from-host.description:
Enable/disable use of HTTP cookie domain from host field in HTTP.   
disable:Disable use of HTTP cookie domain from host field in HTTP (use http-cooke-domain setting).   
enable:Enable use of HTTP cookie domain from host field in HTTP.

http-cookie-domain.description: Domain that HTTP cookie persistence should apply to.

http-cookie-path.description: Limit HTTP cookie persistence to the specified path.

http-cookie-generation.description: Generation of HTTP cookie to be accepted. Changing invalidates all existing cookies.

http-cookie-age.description: Time in minutes that client web browsers should keep a cookie. Default is 60 minutes. 0 = no time limit.

http-cookie-share.description:
Control sharing of cookies across virtual servers. Use of same-ip means a cookie from one virtual server can be used by another. Disable stops cookie sharing.   
disable:Only allow HTTP cookie to match this virtual server.   
same-ip:Allow HTTP cookie to match any virtual server with same IP.

https-cookie-secure.description:
Enable/disable verification that inserted HTTPS cookies are secure.   
disable:Do not mark cookie as secure, allow sharing between an HTTP and HTTPS connection.   
enable:Mark inserted cookie as secure, cookie can only be used for HTTPS a connection.

http-multiplex.description:
Enable/disable HTTP multiplexing.   
enable:Enable HTTP session multiplexing.   
disable:Disable HTTP session multiplexing.

http-ip-header.description:
For HTTP multiplexing, enable to add the original client IP address in the XForwarded-For HTTP header.   
enable:Enable adding HTTP header.   
disable:Disable adding HTTP header.

http-ip-header-name.description: For HTTP multiplexing, enter a custom HTTPS header name. The original client IP address is added to this header. If empty, X-Forwarded-For is used.

outlook-web-access.description:
Enable to add the Front-End-Https header for Microsoft Outlook Web Access.   
disable:Disable Outlook Web Access support.   
enable:Enable Outlook Web Access support.

weblogic-server.description:
Enable to add an HTTP header to indicate SSL offloading for a WebLogic server.   
disable:Do not add HTTP header indicating SSL offload for WebLogic server.   
enable:Add HTTP header indicating SSL offload for WebLogic server.

websphere-server.description:
Enable to add an HTTP header to indicate SSL offloading for a WebSphere server.   
disable:Do not add HTTP header indicating SSL offload for WebSphere server.   
enable:Add HTTP header indicating SSL offload for WebSphere server.

ssl-mode.description:
Apply SSL offloading between the client and the FortiGate (half) or from the client to the FortiGate and from the FortiGate to the server (full).   
half:Client to FortiGate SSL.   
full:Client to FortiGate and FortiGate to Server SSL.

ssl-certificate.description: The name of the certificate to use for SSL handshake.

ssl-dh-bits.description:
Number of bits to use in the Diffie-Hellman exchange for RSA encryption of SSL sessions.   
768:768-bit Diffie-Hellman prime.   
1024:1024-bit Diffie-Hellman prime.   
1536:1536-bit Diffie-Hellman prime.   
2048:2048-bit Diffie-Hellman prime.   
3072:3072-bit Diffie-Hellman prime.   
4096:4096-bit Diffie-Hellman prime.

ssl-algorithm.description:

high:Use AES.   
medium:Use AES, 3DES, or RC4.   
low:Use AES, 3DES, RC4, or DES.   
custom:Use config ssl-cipher-suites to select the cipher suites that are allowed.

ssl-pfs.description:
Select the cipher suites that can be used for SSL perfect forward secrecy (PFS). Applies to both client and server sessions.   
require:Allow only Diffie-Hellman cipher-suites, so PFS is applied.   
deny:Allow only non-Diffie-Hellman cipher-suites, so PFS is not applied.   
allow:Allow use of any cipher suite so PFS may or may not be used depending on the cipher suite selected.

ssl-send-empty-frags.description:
Enable/disable sending empty fragments to avoid CBC IV attacks (SSL 3.0 & TLS 1.0 only). May need to be disabled for compatibility with older systems.   
enable:Send empty fragments.   
disable:Do not send empty fragments.

ssl-client-fallback.description:
Enable/disable support for preventing Downgrade Attacks on client connections (RFC 7507).   
disable:Disable.   
enable:Enable.

ssl-client-renegotiation.description:
Allow, deny, or require secure renegotiation of client sessions to comply with RFC 5746.   
allow:Allow a SSL client to renegotiate.   
deny:Abort any SSL connection that attempts to renegotiate.   
secure:Reject any SSL connection that does not offer a RFC 5746 Secure Renegotiation Indication.

ssl-client-session-state-type.description:
How to expire SSL sessions for the segment of the SSL connection between the client and the FortiGate.   
disable:Do not keep session states.   
time:Expire session states after this many minutes.   
count:Expire session states when this maximum is reached.   
both:Expire session states based on time or count, whichever occurs first.

ssl-client-session-state-timeout.description: Number of minutes to keep client to FortiGate SSL session state.

ssl-client-session-state-max.description: Maximum number of client to FortiGate SSL session states to keep.

ssl-client-rekey-count.description: Maximum length of data in MB before triggering a client rekey (0 = disable).

ssl-server-session-state-type.description:
How to expire SSL sessions for the segment of the SSL connection between the server and the FortiGate.   
disable:Do not keep session states.   
time:Expire session states after this many minutes.   
count:Expire session states when this maximum is reached.   
both:Expire session states based on time or count, whichever occurs first.

ssl-server-session-state-timeout.description: Number of minutes to keep FortiGate to Server SSL session state.

ssl-server-session-state-max.description: Maximum number of FortiGate to Server SSL session states to keep.

ssl-http-location-conversion.description:
Enable to replace HTTP with HTTPS in the reply's Location HTTP header field.   
enable:Enable HTTP location conversion.   
disable:Disable HTTP location conversion.

ssl-http-match-host.description:
Enable/disable HTTP host matching for location conversion.   
enable:Match HTTP host in response header.   
disable:Do not match HTTP host.

ssl-hpkp.description:
Enable/disable including HPKP header in response.   
disable:Do not add a HPKP header to each HTTP response.   
enable:Add a HPKP header to each a HTTP response.   
report-only:Add a HPKP Report-Only header to each HTTP response.

ssl-hpkp-primary.description: Certificate to generate primary HPKP pin from.

ssl-hpkp-backup.description: Certificate to generate backup HPKP pin from.

ssl-hpkp-age.description: Number of minutes the web browser should keep HPKP.

ssl-hpkp-report-uri.description: URL to report HPKP violations to.

ssl-hpkp-include-subdomains.description:
Indicate that HPKP header applies to all subdomains.   
disable:HPKP header does not apply to subdomains.   
enable:HPKP header applies to subdomains.

ssl-hsts.description:
Enable/disable including HSTS header in response.   
disable:Do not add a HSTS header to each a HTTP response.   
enable:Add a HSTS header to each HTTP response.

ssl-hsts-age.description: Number of seconds the client should honor the HSTS setting.

ssl-hsts-include-subdomains.description:
Indicate that HSTS header applies to all subdomains.   
disable:HSTS header does not apply to subdomains.   
enable:HSTS header applies to subdomains.

monitor.description: Name of the health check monitor to use when polling to determine a virtual server's connectivity status.

embedded-ipv4-address.description:

parameters.name: vdom
parameters.description:
Specify the Virtual Domain(s) from which results are returned or changes are applied to. If this parameter is not provided, the management VDOM will be used. If the admin does not have access to the VDOM, a permission error will be returned.
The URL parameter is one of:
vdom=root (Single VDOM)
vdom=vdom1,vdom2 (Multiple VDOMs)
vdom=* (All VDOMs)

parameters.name: action
parameters.description:
If supported, an action can be specified.
_clone_: Clone this specific resource.
When *action=clone* is set, the extra parameters *nkey* must be provided.
__*Note:*__ If this parameter is provided when not supported, the action will be ignored and an “invalid request” error will be returned.

parameters.name: nkey
parameters.description:
If *action=clone*, use *nkey* to specify the ID for the new resource to be created.
For example, to clone `address1` to `address1_clone`, use:
__action=clone&nkey=address1_clone__
__*Note:*__ This parameter can only be used when the *action* parameter is set to *clone*.
